descriptions: Fly 76-seat Embraer 175 routes across the Mountain West, about 80 block hours a month
Completed initial operating experience in 25 hours with no extra training events
Serve on the airline's safety action program review team, reading crew reports and suggesting procedure changes
Logged about 1,200 hours of dual instruction and recommended 31 students for checkrides with a 94% first-time pass rate
Wrote the school's instrument ground school syllabus and taught it to classes of 10
Checked new instructors on standardization flights and kept the training records for FAA audits
Fueled and towed business jets and turboprops, and kept fuel quality records for daily inspections
